proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ A B C D hiso hD
  have stew : ∀ D : P, Sbtw ℝ B D C → dist A B ^ 2 * dist D C + dist A C ^ 2 * dist B D =
      dist B C * (dist A D ^ 2 + dist B D * dist D C) := by
    intro D hD
    have h := EuclideanGeometry.dist_sq_mul_dist_add_dist_sq_mul_dist A B C D hD.angle₁₂₃_eq_pi
    rwa [dist_comm C D] at h
  have h := stew D hD
  have hs := hD.wbtw.dist_add_dist
  have hBC : dist B C ≠ 0 := dist_ne_zero.mpr hD.left_ne_right
  apply mul_left_cancel₀ hBC
  rw [← hiso] at h
  rw [← hs] at h ⊢
  linear_combination h
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (A B C D : P), dist A B = dist A C → Sbtw ℝ B D C → dist A B ^ 2 - dist A D ^ 2 = dist B D * dist D C
